About ACE

A place for students who want to do more than just talk about engineering.

ACE gives members opportunities to design, manufacture, program, test, compete, collaborate, and develop leadership through real projects.

Built around practical experience

Members can start with little or no prior experience and learn directly from other students, project leads, technical mentors, workshops, and competition teams.


Our focus is simple: give students access to meaningful engineering work, a place to build, and a team that expects projects to actually function.

What We Do

Projects that turn classroom knowledge into working systems.

ACE projects are designed to create technical ownership, teamwork, and real design iteration.

Competition

Combat Robotics

Design, fabricate, wire, test, and compete with combat robots in ACE events and external competition.

Engineering Design

Design Competition

Work in teams to take technical challenges from concept through CAD, prototyping, testing, and a finished competitive solution.

Technical Development

Workshops & Collaboration

Develop CAD, programming, manufacturing, simulation, and project-planning skills in a team environment.

ACE Lab

A dedicated place to build.

The ACE Lab gives teams space to prototype, assemble, test, meet, and keep projects moving outside normal class hours.
